device.type: DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C Full HD H.265/HEVC 10-bit combo receiver with CI+ slot, CA card reader and Ethernet / Wi-Fi
device.board: HASG1 bootloader version "39087-01047" (256 MB DDR3 C3505 combo board)
device.soc: ALi C3505 with 256 MB DDR3 (maincode "ALI_C3505:0x%x", seecode "M3505 SEE" at 0xAE000200)
device.demod: internal DVB-S2 (NIM_S3505_0) + external Availink AVL6862 / AVL6762 DVB-T2/C on SCB3 at I2C 0x14
device.tuner: ALi M3031 at I2C 0x20 (DVB-S2) + Rafael Micro R836 at I2C 0x3A (DVB-T2/C)

source.author: Ferguson
source.note: Official firmware archive Ferguson_A255_V1.32B4.zip from Ferguson's download server; fetched 2026-10-31.

simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB DDR3 C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_a255_app_starts.py, run_dump_a255_capture_screen.py): its boot-ROM bootloader runs in boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800 while reading the chunk table through the 0xAFC00000 flash window, unpacks maincode to 0x80000200 and seecode to 0xAE000200 (224 MB physical DDR), then sets 0xB8000220 bit 24 (0xB8000223 bit 0) before jumping to maincode -- switching physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF from the flash window to the top 16 MB of DDR (240..256 MB, used for video/GMA buffers) and restoring 0xBFE00000..0xBFEFFFFF to the 0xBF800000..0xBFFFFFFF 8 MB flash mirror so SYS_FLASH_BASE_ADDR = 0xBFC00000 sees the whole SPI image.  The application moves EBase to 0x80002000, starts the SEE co-processor at 0xAE000200 (EBase 0x8E002001), initialises the internal S3505 DVB-S2 demodulator + ALi M3031 tuner (0x20 on SCB1) and the external Availink AVL6862 DVB-T2/C demodulator (0x14 on SCB3 at 0xB8018D00) + Rafael Micro R836 tuner (0x3A), drives the FD650K front panel on GPIO 107 / 108 (" O  ", " On ", " on ", "StAr", "nenu"), and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 "System Setup" OSD menu through the display engine at 0xB8006900.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 255 Combo official firmware V1.32B4 (2020-12-24) for the Full HD H.265/HEVC 10-bit DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C CI+ combo receiver on the ALi C3505 SoC with 256 MB DDR3.

Unlike the 128 MB C3505 Ariva 104 / 204 / 154 Combo / 254 Combo / T760i builds (SEE at 0xA6000200, flash at 0xAFC00000), the Ariva 255 Combo places its SEE program at 0xAE000200, remaps 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to DDR via 0xB8000220 bit 24, reads flash from 0xBF800000..0xBFFFFFFF (SYS_FLASH_BASE_ADDR 0xBFC00000), and talks to an Availink AVL6862 / AVL6762 DVB-T2/C demodulator on the C3505's fourth I2C master SCB3 (0xB8018D00).
